title: The "Fog" Sudoku You Demanded We Solve!
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

We asked you in yesterday's video to select the puzzle Simon would attempt today and the overwhelming response was Embark by dumediat.  (Although, rest assured, Simon intends to have a go at KNT's intriguing Pathfinder sudoku at some point).  Embark is another "Fog" sudoku and we'd like to applaud Chameleon's programming skills for creating a UI especially for this puzzle.  Do have a go at this one - it IS amazing.

Play it at the link below:

https://tinyurl.com/3wbmu73f

If you can't use tinyurl then this link should work:

https://yusitnikov.github.io/puzzletv/#embarkation 

Rules: 

Place correct digits, shading, or loop lines into the cells to clear the fog. Contained within the grid are nine non-overlapping 3x3 square regions which must be located. Each region contains the digits 1 to 9 once each, and digits cannot repeat in any row or column. Cells outside regions do not contain digits and are considered "empty" for rules below. The digits in each cage sum to the clue in the top left corner, and may not repeat. Cages may include shaded and/or unshaded empty cells, but such cells do not contribute to the cage total. Shade some empty cells black so that no two shaded cells are orthogonally adjacent (including given shaded cells), and draw a non-intersecting loop through the centres of all unshaded empty cells. Arrow clues must contain a digit and be part of a 3x3 region; these clues represent the number of shaded cells in a straight line in the indicated direction. In the final grid, all cells will contain either a digit (with or without an arrow), a loop line, or black shading.

title: YOU Choose Tomorrow's Puzzle!!!
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

An absolute belter today from Dag H with Yin Yang Renban, a quite sublime puzzle hybrid of sudoku and the logic puzzle Yin Yang.  We're also delighted to present viewers with a choice about the puzzle Simon will attempt in tomorrow's video.  We've never done this before and we're not sure whether it will be popular.  We've identified two puzzles that have been requested a lot so please drop us a comment to let us know which you'd prefer to see and why (Links to these puzzles are included below).

Play Yin Yang Renban at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/gj49HRdbGh

Rules: 

Normal sudoku rules apply. Every cell in the grid is either shaded or unshaded. All shaded cells form an orthogonally connected group; all unshaded cells form an orthogonally connected group. No 2x2 area may be fully shaded or fully unshaded. Every cell with a circle is shaded. The number in a circle is equal to the number of shaded cells “seen” by that cell, including itself; ie the total number of shaded cells in uninterrupted vertical and horizontal lines from that cell. Digits along a pink line form a consecutive, non-repeating sequence. These digits can appear in any order.

title: Are They Vampires Or Prey?! More Sudoku Perfection
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

Seriously seriously clever stuff today from Mad-Tyas and their sudoku Vampires - which features two types of interlinked modifier cells!  It's an absolutely stunning puzzle that's achieved a coveted 100% approval rating on Logic Masters Germany.

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/29B449j9RJ

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. In cages, digits must not repeat and must sum to the small clue in the top left corner of their cage. However the value a digit contributes to the cage sum can be altered by the Vampire rule. Nine cells in the grid are Vampires. All Vampire cells contain different digits. Each row, column and marked 3x3 box contains exactly one Vampire cell. Vampire cells must not repeat in cages. There also are nine Prey cells, which follow the same rules as the Vampire cells. A cell can only have one of these two roles. For cage totals: Prey cells contribute 0; Vampire cells contribute the sum of the digits in the Vampire cell and Prey cell in that same marked 3x3 box.

title: Year of the Rabbit: Perseverance will be Required
description:
Here's where you can try Year of the Rabbit 2023 by Morisenseiisgod: https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/RdMFQGFqdn 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Any three consecutive digits on a red modular line must have different remainders when divided by 3. A clue outside the grid gives the sum of the digits on the marked diagonal. Digits may repeat on a diagonal where allowed by other rules. Digits on the grey circles sum to a factor of 2023, and digits on the grey line sum to a multiple of 8. It is up to the solver to deduce these sums.

Here are the URLs for today's 5 GAS (Genuinely Approachable Sudoku) puzzles. Hat times are given as (two hats/one hat). Any correct solution gets you a dinosaur. NOTE that there are no f-puzzles links this time due to matters affecting that platform at the time that these puzzles were originally posted.

GAS 556 – David and Goliath by Bill Murphy https://tinyurl.com/7hanbxm2  
Normal sudoku rules apply. Each capsule must contain one low digit (12345) and one high digit (56789). (8:00/15:00)

GAS 557 – Have a Holly Jolly Classic by Philip Newman  https://tinyurl.com/mryfdtnb 
Normal sudoku rules apply. And that’s it! (6:00/12:00)

GAS 558 – Delimited Kropki by clover! https://tinyurl.com/4ney6tck   
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in cells joined by a white dot are consecutive, and digits in cells joined by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT ALERT : Along the gray lines, all possible dots are given. (7:00/13:00)

GAS 559 – Serial Killers by Bill Murphy  https://tinyurl.com/n5xatfn3  
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in cages must sum to the total given, and in each cage at least one digit must repeat. (8:30/16:00)

GAS 560 – Feliz Naviquad by Philip Newman https://tinyurl.com/muf297kw  
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in circles must appear within the four surrounding cells.
(8:00/16:00)

title: The Puzzle Of Harvey "Two Face" Dent
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

A superb parity based sudoku today from the brilliant mind of Mr.Menace!  It's called Two Face and we like to think it might be a homage to The Dark Knight, one of Simon's favourite films!

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/6tjbqNGt37

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Cells containing a grey square must contain even digits. Along a red line, digits must alternate parity (so, if the first digit is odd, the next digit must be even, etc). The sum of the digits along a blue line must be the same total N within each 3x3 box the line passes through. eg r8c6 = r8c7 + r7c7 = r6c8 + r5c8 +r5c9

title: The Extraordinary 72-Cell Sudoku Puzzle
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

JanForty set this puzzle, Mean Samuria, in a speed-setting competition (we think he had less than one hour, possibly a lot less!).  He is one of the fastest solvers on the planet and it turns out something of a genius at setting as well.  These 4x4 linked grids (samurai style!) are absolutely amazing.

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/FnhPdg2LDq

Or, if you can use tinyurl links, the following link has the solution built in:

https://tinyurl.com/mean-samurai-sudoku

Rules: 
Each of the coloured areas and the centre 4x4 is a 4x4 sudoku grid using four of the digits 1-9. Different areas may use different digits. Adjacent digits along a green line must differ by at least 5. A pink line contains a set of consecutive numbers, in any order. (In green, there are two separate lines that cross). Digits along an arrow sum to the digit in that arrow's circle. Cells separated by a black dot contain digits in a 1:2 ratio (ie one digit will be double the other). Cells separated by an X contain digits that sum to 10.

title: The Colour Of Numbers
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

Eric Rathbun's Mini Palindromes proves that beautiful things come in small packages!  Those lines might look miniature but they pack a mighty logical punch - this one will make you smile.

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/4Bqg3BgfBg

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in a cage sum to the digit in the top left corner of the cage. Clues outside the grid give the sum of the digits along the indicated diagonal. Cells separated by a knight's move (in chess) cannot contain the same digit. Grey lines are palindromes ie they read the same forwards and backwards.

title: Good King WencesGAS
description:
Here are the URLs for today's 5 GAS (Genuinely Approachable Sudoku) puzzles. Hat times are given as (two hats/one hat). Any correct solution gets you a dinosaur.

GAS 551 – Wonderful Christmasprime by Philip Newman https://tinyurl.com/4h5ppcv4 
https://f-puzzles.com/?id=2dwz93fc 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Each digit in column 2 indicates the location of the 2 in that row. For example, a 9 in r1c2 would indicate that the 2 in row 1 is in the ninth cell (r1c9). Likewise, each digit in columns 3, 5, and 7 indicates the location of 3, 5, and 7 respectively. (8:00/16:00)

GAS 552 – German Whispers by clover  https://tinyurl.com/2r3cmhhm 
https://f-puzzles.com/?id=2fz6qyaq 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits along a green line must differ by at least 5. (8:00/15:00)

GAS 553 – Daytime Sudoku by Bill Murphy 
“Canon” version (GAS level) (8:00/14:00) https://tinyurl.com/2p9ava4v 
https://f-puzzles.com/?id=2zlrlpbb  
“Non-canon” version (GAS-Leak level) (9:00/15:00) https://tinyurl.com/bdh3rdjc 
https://f-puzzles.com/?id=2gtjapgj 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Identical digits cannot appear in cells a chess knight’s move apart. 

GAS 554 – Wonderful Christmaslime by Philip Newman  https://tinyurl.com/5p2asymy  
https://f-puzzles.com/?id=2psqfrxd
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in cells directly connected by a green line must differ by at least 5. Digits along the green line of each "lime" must sum to the value given by the two cells surrounded by the line (read top to bottom or left to right as a 2-digit number). (7:30/15:00)

GAS 555 – Two Sudokus by clover 
Pen-pa https://tinyurl.com/2gz8fx85 
CTC – two grids on one page: https://tinyurl.com/yckstmm5 
CTC – one grid on each page (must be solved simultaneously): https://tinyurl.com/2cy9xnay / https://tinyurl.com/yruw8mt3 
Normal 6x6 sudoku rules apply within each grid. Digits may never appear in the same position in the two grids. (7:30/14:00)

title: The Perfectly Symmetrical Sudoku Tree
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

James Sinclair's sudoku, Semal Tree, is so symmetrical (especially the tree part) that you might wonder how it solves uniquely.  It does and it has some really interesting logic hidden inside it!

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/F8rR6n2pdb

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits cannot repeat along the blue diagonal. Digits along an arrow sum to the digit in that arrow's circle. A pink line contains a set of non-repeating consecutive digits. These digits can appear in any order. Cells separated by a white dot must contain consecutive digits.

title: The Sudoku With Only One Visible Cell?!
description:
*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

Albin Bernhardsson's Foggy Ninefield is a fantastic riff on the Fog-Of-War sudokus we've been loving so much.  Don't cheat by guessing digits - everything is deducible logically and it's quite fantastic!!

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/gphj7LF93b

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. The grid is covered mostly in darkness. Placing correct digits in cells will illuminate more of the grid. Digits must not repeat within a cage, and must sum to the given total. The given total is always in the uppermost, leftmost cell in the cage. All cells which correctly show the number of adjacent nines (including diagonally) are marked with circles.

title: Be Quiet, I'm Solving a Sudoku
description:
Here's where you can try Shush by HaFlam: https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/QPBrmH3qpq

title: The Miracle Sudoku With Just Four Circles
description:
*** THE SUDOKU EVENTS OF THE YEAR ***
Phistomefel's first ever sudoku hunt is OUT and today is the last chance to submit the answer phrase and win a shout-out on the channel!!! 

https://www.patreon.com/crackingthecryptic

*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

One of Simon's favourite puzzles of recent times.  Atoll by Math Pesto is a totally brilliant sudoku with a whole bunch of "Aha" moments.  Make sure you try this one!

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/m73tnQmbbd

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Draw a loop (which never intersects with itself) through the centres of some cells. The loop moves from cell to cell orthogonally. Every cell in the grid is one of three types: fully inside the loop, fully outside the loop, or part of the loop. A 2x2 area cannot be entirely one cell type. A green circle is inside the loop, a blue circle is outside the loop, and a yellow circle is part of the loop. A digit placed in a circle is the number of cells of its own type that it “sees” horizontally and vertically, including itself. (Other cell types obstruct vision.) Cells inside the loop form one orthogonally connected area and cells outside the loop are orthogonally connected to the edge of the grid. Adjacent non-loop cells contain digits that differ by 5 or more.

title: How Can These Sudoku Rules Ever Work?
description:
*** THE SUDOKU EVENTS OF THE YEAR ***
Phistomefel's first ever sudoku hunt is OUT!!! We've gifted it as a Christmas present to all our patrons to say "Thank you" for supporting us. 

Jay Dyer's sudoku hunt - Numeric Alchemy - OUT THIS WEEK - is already generating exceptional feedback.  Join us on Patreon for as little as $2/month.  The best "$:puzzle entertainment ratio" in the world!

https://www.patreon.com/crackingthecryptic

*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

Today Simon attempts a puzzle he's wanted to try for a while but has been slightly scared of given its reputation.  It's called Numbered Regions, it's the work of the brilliant Jesper Josefsson and the ruleset is absolutely mad.  How can this have a solution?!?!  Let's see...

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/Hf9QqQMD7J

Rules: 
Divide the grid into regions, each consisting of nine orthogonally connected cells. Each row, column and region must contain the digits 1 to 9 once each. The digit in the top-left cell of a region (its leftmost cell in its highest row) is its “region number”. All region numbers are different. If a cell with the digit X in a region with the number N contains an arrow, then the cell X steps away in the indicated direction belongs to the region numbered N+1. Not all possible arrows are given.

description:
*** THE SUDOKU EVENTS OF THE YEAR ***
Phistomefel's first ever sudoku hunt is OUT!!! We've gifted it as a Christmas present to all our patrons to say "Thank you" for supporting us. 

Jay Dyer's sudoku hunt - Numeric Alchemy - OUT YESTERDAY - is already generating exceptional feedback.  Join us on Patreon for as little as $2/month.  The best "$:puzzle entertainment ratio" in the world!

https://www.patreon.com/crackingthecryptic

*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

This puzzle - called Coordinated Killers by Samish - has been recommended to us many times.  It seems like the small change to normal killer sudoku rules might not do too much - until you try and solve it!!!  This is VERY clever puzzle making.

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/8H44MjMNTR

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. In cages, digits may not repeat and each cage (clued as a small number in its top left corner) is either a "killer" cage or a "coordinate" cage. In killer cages, the clue gives the sum of the digits in the cage. In coordinate cages, the clue spells out the coordinates of a cell that is the sum of the digits in the cage. The solver must determine which cage is which. eg if a cage's clue is 12 then its digits either sum to 12 or to the digit in r1c2 (ie row 1, column 2).

Normal sudoku rules apply. Digits in cages do not repeat, and must sum to the small clue in the top left corner of the cage. Normal sudoku rules apply. Draw a non-intersecting loop through the centres of some cells. The loop travels orthogonally from cell to cell. The loop may not enter coloured cells that contain a green, grey or black square. Green squares must lie inside the loop; black squares must lie outside the loop; grey cells may either be inside or outside the loop – the solver must discover which. A clue outside a row gives the sum of the digits on the closest horizontal loop segment passing through its row (including the cells in which the loop turns); likewise for columns and vertical segments.

title: Secret Santa: Sudoku Style!
description:
*** THE SUDOKU EVENTS OF THE YEAR ***
Huge news:  Phistomefel's first ever sudoku hunt is OUT!!! We've gifted it as a Christmas present to all our patrons to say "Thank you" for supporting us. 

We've also got Jay Dyer's sudoku hunt - Numeric Alchemy - OUT TODAY (and this is another EXTRAORDINARY thing!)

https://www.patreon.com/crackingthecryptic

*** TODAY'S PUZZLE ***

The recent Secret Santa event on the CtC Discord has yielded lots of amazing puzzles and this one, by Charlie Pugh, is the first we'll feature.  It's called A Mid Sum-mer Christmas and it's simply gorgeous!!

Play it at the link below:

https://app.crackingthecryptic.com/sudoku/Nmg943btqh

Rules: 
Normal sudoku rules apply. Cells separated by a king's move (in chess) cannot contain the same digit. Digits along an arrow must sum to the digit in that arrow's circle. All digits along the green line must sum to the same number in each 3x3 box the line visits. Different visits to the same 3x3 box all count towards the same total for that box. (eg r4c3+r5c2+r5c3+r6c3 = r3c4+r2c5+r3c6.) Stars in the grid represent a single digit N. A cell containing a star must contain that digit N, and any two cells connected by a star must contain digits summing to that same number N.
